Applications are invited on prescribed format for a purely temporary posts on contractual basis for the project
enitled 4 Muiti-centric parallel arm randomized clinical trial to improve treutment outcomes among persons
with drug sensitive pulmonary TB treated with 4 or 6 months of High dose Rifampicin containing regimens with
or without Levoflovcin" under the Project Investigator Dr. Rajiv Garg, Professor, Department of Respiratory
Medicine, KGMU, Lucknow funded by Indian Council of Medical Research, New Delhi. Appointment shall be
made tor the initially for the period of six months extendable for one year depending upon performance of
candidates. Appointment of selected candidates can be terminated at any time under unsatis factory performance.
Selected candidate cannot claim for regular appointment and position will cease to exist when project is completed.
2
Interested candidates with requisite qualifications and experience may submit duly filled application form at
research. rmkgmu@gmail.com on or before 17th July 2026. No hard copy will be entertained. Shortlisted
candidates will be informed by e-mail in advance and required to appear in interview. The interview is scheduled to
be held on 21" July 2026 at 1.00 p.m. in the office of undersigned. No separate call letter will be dispatched for
interview. No TA/DA will be admissible for attending interview.
